messages.text:
Before editing, I’m checking one subtle observable boundary: Nushell sometimes emits string results without an added newline, while numeric/table display does add one.

That affects exact stdout byte matching, so I’m measuring bytes directly instead of relying on terminal display.

commands.commandLine:
python - <<'PY'
import subprocess, pathlib
ref=pathlib.Path('REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip()
for c in ['"abc"','"hello world" | split row " " | get 1','[a b c] | str join "-"','1','true','[1,2] | to json -r','[[a b]; [1 2]] | to csv','null','pwd','char nl']:
    p=subprocess.run([ref,'-c',c],capture_output=True)
    print('CASE',c)
    print('code',p.returncode,'stdout',repr(p.stdout.decode(errors='replace')),'stderr',repr(p.stderr.decode(errors='replace')))
PY
